annotations.text:
Four tabs, not six.
Today the trainee gets one scrolling page with no navigation at all. Grouping into Home / Learn / Attendance / Career keeps the bar under the 5-item ceiling and leaves room for P1 and P2 without adding tabs.
Career absorbs four features behind one segmented control: Jobs, Skill gap (P1), Ask (P2). This is what stops the navbar overloading as Phase-2 lands.
Every answer shows what it actually looked up. P2 returns toolCalls for exactly this — the trainee can see the advice came from their own record, not a guess.
Tweak on this artboard: turn Show reasoning off to see the P1 fallback state, when the AI layer is unavailable and only the deterministic gap is shown.
Same four groups become a top nav at the real 1126px root width. Base type steps 16px to 18px here, matching the app breakpoint.
